name: text-reveal
title: Text reveal
description: Fade a sentence in word by word. Static for reduced motion.
a11y: The text stays real text in reading order; nothing is hidden from assistive tech.
With prefers-reduced-motion every word is visible at once.

props.name: text
props.description: The sentence to reveal, word by word.

usage:
import {TextReveal} from '@monoline/react';

<TextReveal text="Every word arrives in turn, so the eye can follow the sentence." style={{fontFamily: 'var(--font-display)', fontSize: 'var(--display-sm)'}} />
